plan.title: Service PR to Split Award and PO

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule; the exact evaluation duration cannot be parameterized.
Invite two QA test vendors without inventing real supplier names.
Publish the configured Technical plus RFQ event.
Verify publishing reached a real project page.
Have the first invited vendor answer the technical stage and submit a quote of 100 per activity.
Verify the first vendor's submission was accepted.
Have the second invited vendor answer the technical stage and submit a quote of 90 per activity.
Verify the second vendor's submission was accepted.
Wait for bidding to end as required before evaluation and awarding.
Submit the assigned evaluator's technical scoring after the technical window closes.
Open the buyer comparison grid after evaluation and bidding are complete.
Verify the lower-priced vendor ranks first.
Enter the awarding screen to allocate the two activities.
Allocate an activity to one vendor as part of the split award.
Allocate the remaining activity to the other vendor; exact activity identity cannot be selected by this step.
Verify both activities and both vendors are represented in the split allocation.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Submit the created proposal for approval.
Approve the submitted proposal with the required remark.
Complete approval and create the resulting purchase orders.
Verify the created purchase orders contain the two awarded activity lines.
Open the events list to verify the event reached history.
Switch to the History tab.
Verify this plan's event appears in event history.
